name: T3 Code
tagline: Drive your coding-agent threads from any MCP client.
description: T3 Code runs Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other coding agents on your own machine. Each T3 Code environment serves an MCP server that lets an outside agent read projects and threads, start and message threads, and list the available providers and models.

methods.label: OAuth 2.0 (per environment)
methods.note: Dynamic client registration with S256 PKCE. You approve each agent on the environment and pick read-only or an operating mode.

auth.guide:
**MCP with OAuth (only path):** there is no shared hosted server. Every T3 Code environment serves its own MCP endpoint at `https://<environment-address>/mcp`. Copy it from **Settings → Connections → (environment menu) → Copy MCP URL**.

```bash
claude mcp add --transport http t3 https://$T3_ENVIRONMENT/mcp
claude mcp login t3
```

The login opens a sign-in page on the environment. Approve it with a pairing code from **Settings → Connections** or `t3 auth pairing create` on the host, then choose what the agent may do. **Read only** is the default; **Supervised** through **Full access** let it start, message and stop threads. A sign-in lasts 30 days.

**Reachability is the gotcha.** An agent on your own machines can use a LAN, Tailscale or `localhost` address. A hosted agent such as ChatGPT needs the environment's T3 Connect address, because it connects from the internet.

**Codex:** `codex mcp add t3 --url https://$T3_ENVIRONMENT/mcp`, then `codex mcp login t3`. Clients without OAuth support cannot connect.

variables.description: Your T3 Code environment's address. Copy the full MCP URL from Settings → Connections → Copy MCP URL. Hosted agents such as ChatGPT need the T3 Connect address.

interfaces.note: Self-hosted: every environment serves its own endpoint. OAuth with dynamic client registration and S256 PKCE; scopes orchestration:read and orchestration:operate.

interfaces.name: t3
interfaces.note: Starts the T3 Code server and local web app. Install permanently with `curl -fsSL https://t3.codes/install.sh | sh`.
